items.title: 6.1 Definition and Overview of Emerging Technologies

source_refs.note: Topic 6.1 with the chapter introduction (PDF 154-155, printed 151-152). The learning outcomes (PDF 153) are not reproduced. 'IaaS' and 'IoT' print as 'laaS' and 'loT' throughout.

blocks.text: This chapter explores two of the most transformative technologies of our time, cloud computing and blockchain: the core ideas and service and deployment models of the cloud, the principles, components and uses of blockchain, and future trends such as edge computing, serverless architectures and Blockchain 2.0.

blocks.title: Emerging technologies
blocks.text: Emerging technologies are new tools, systems and methods that are being developed or have just started to be used, with the potential to change how we live, work and interact with the world.

blocks.caption: Key emerging technologies
rows: machines that learn and decide like humans
store and use data and apps over the internet
a shared record that is very hard to change
everyday objects connected to the internet
digital layers on the real world; fully virtual worlds
much faster, more reliable wireless connections
phones, smart devices, AR and VR
quantum physics for very hard problems
living organisms used to make products

blocks.prompt: How is AR different from VR?
blocks.explanation: AR adds digital elements to the real world (through a phone or glasses); VR replaces the real world with a completely virtual environment.

items: Emerging technologies: AI, cloud, blockchain, IoT, AR/VR, 5G, quantum computing, biotechnology; this chapter focuses on cloud and blockchain.
